 The Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Murahari Sri Raman
 Order
07.03.2026 (Hybrid Mode) Order No.
01. I.A. No.584 of 2026
1.
This Interlocutory Application has been filed by the appellants for condonation of delay of 54 days in preferring this appeal.

2. Heard Mr. Malaya Kumar Swain, learned counsel appearing for the appellant-informant and Mr.
Partha Sarathi Nayak, learned Additional Government Advocate appearing for the respondent no.1-State.

3. By the impugned judgment dated 9th October, 2025 passed in T.R. Case No.86 of 2024 arising out of Nayagarh P.S. Case No.142, dated 22.04.2024, the learned Additional Sessions Judge-cum-Special Court under the POCSO Act, Nayagarh acquitted the respondent no.2 from the offence under Sections 363/366(part 1)/376(2)(n)/376(3) of the IPC and Section 6 of the POCSO Act, 2012.
Aggrieved by the said judgment of acquittal, the informant filed the appeal along with the present Interlocutory Application for condonation of said delay of 54 days.
4. Issue notice to the respondents.

sentences.text: As Mr. Partha Sarathi Nayak, learned AGA has appeared on behalf of respondent no.1, notice on said respondent is waived.

No further notice be issued to the said respondent no.1.
6.
The appellant-informant shall take steps for service of notice upon the respondent no.2 by Speed Post with registration, and proof of delivery shall be filed within the next five working days.

7. List this matter after eight weeks on a date to be fixed by the Registry after due service of notice upon the respondent no.2.
8. Liberty to mention.
9.

Registry shall apprise this Court as to whether the State have preferred any appeal against the impugned judgment dated 9th October, 2025 passed by the learned Additional Sessions Judge-cum-Special Court under the POCSO Act, Nayagarh in T.R. Case No.86 of 2024 arising out of Nayagarh P.S. Case No.142, dated 22.04.2024 or not.
(Manash Ranjan Pathak) Judge (Murahari Sri Raman) Judge Bichi/Laxmikant Signed by:
LAXMIKANT MOHAPATRA
